_about: Machine-readable conditions for numeric time rules (D39). measure = minutes from the 'from' moment to the 'to' moment, read from the records by src/agents/collector_tools.rule_checks. The condition is what the rule's own scope text says; it holds when 'measure op value'. Keyed by rule name; a case may override with a 'check' inside the rule. inclusive_keys: case rules that say whether exactly the limit counts; without one, a measure exactly at the limit is reported as such.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.condition: the rider cancelled within {value} min of the driver being matched

free_wait_time_min.condition: the driver had waited at least {value} min at the pickup, counted from arrival, when the booking was cancelled

no_show_threshold_min.condition: the driver had waited at least {value} min at the pickup, counted from arrival, when the booking was cancelled

no_fee_if_driver_delayed_beyond_eta_min.condition: the driver was more than {value} min past the arrival time shown at assignment (arrival, or cancellation if the driver never arrived)

advanced_trip_free_cancellation_min_befo.condition: the rider cancelled at least {value} min before the scheduled pickup time
